card.name: Linking words before body-weight or control terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words, spaces or verbs such as 'at', 'of', 'maintaining' just before a goal or measure like bedtime, pain control, a number, or body weight. Seen in advice and dosing text.

modes.label: Words before 'control of'
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'control' before a condition such as pain or hypertension.
modes.example: For control<< of>> severe chronic pain, Oxycodone

modes.label: Before a number or weight
modes.description: A space or verb just before a figure or a body-weight phrase.
modes.example: Measure blood pressure around<< >>40 minutes post-dose and subsequently

modes.label: Timing and lifestyle advice
modes.description: Linking word in advice on checking sugar or keeping healthy habits.
modes.example: especially after exercise and<< at>> bedtime. Keep fast-acting sugars handy

card.writes: It seems to suppress words about stimulus, stimulation and fluids as the next word, and slightly favors weight-related words.
card.plain: It fires on small words that lead into a target, such as a time, a number, body weight or pain control.
